title: Finite-Time Observability of Oscillatory Instabilities in Synchronous p-bit Dynamics
summary: Synchronous update schemes in p-bit annealing offer a natural route to massive parallelism, but they can also induce period-2 oscillations that degrade optimization performance. In practical solvers, such oscillations matter only if they become observable within the finite runtime of the device or simulation, yet most existing analyses are formulated in terms of asymptotic stability. As a result, they do not directly address the experimentally relevant question of when oscillatory modes actually appear during finite-duration annealing. Here we develop a finite-time observability framework…
